Do you enjoy working with your hands and solving technical challenges? We are looking for a Workshop Mechanic to support technical projects involving the assembly, modification, and maintenance of large vehicles and mechanical systems. Earn between €3,000 and €3,800 gross per month, work in a day shift schedule, and further develop your technical skills in a hands-on environment. Apply today!

Employment agency Manpower is looking for a Workshop Mechanic for a client in Twello.

As a Workshop Mechanic, you will work on a variety of technical projects. You will help build, modify, repair, and maintain mechanical systems and components. Your responsibilities include:

    - Assembling and disassembling mechanical components
    
- Installing, removing, and replacing parts
    
- Performing technical modifications and repair work
    
- Working with hand tools and power tools
    
- Following technical drawings and work instructions
    
- Supporting maintenance and project activities
    
- Contributing to a safe and organized workplace

What’s in it for you?

    - Gross monthly salary between €3,000 and €3,800
    
- Travel allowance of €0.21 per kilometer
    
- Pension accrual through Manpower
    
- Temporary employment contract through Manpower
    
- Project duration of up to one year
    
- Position for 32 to 38 hours per week
    
- Day shift schedule, five days per week
    
- Opportunity to develop and expand your technical skills
    
- Varied and hands-on work in a technical environment

    - MBO Level 2 or a similar technical background
    
- Technical insight and a hands-on mentality
    
- Experience working on vehicles, machinery, or mechanical equipment is an advantage
    
- Comfortable using hand tools and power tools
    
- Willingness to learn and develop technical skills
    
- Availability for 32 to 38 hours per week
    
- Good command of Dutch and/or English

Are you technically minded and do you enjoy practical, hands-on work? Apply today and start your next challenge as a Workshop Mechan

Join Schneider Electric in Helmond as a Reach Truck driver. Then this is your chance! Through Adecco, you will be working a steady full-time (40 hours per week) as a reach truck driver at Schneider Electric, a leading international company with a modern, safe, and tightly organized distribution center in Helmond.

What are you going to do?
As a reach truck driver at Schneider Electric, you and your team are responsible for the entire logistics process in the warehouse. You ensure that goods reach the customer safely, on time, and in top condition.

Your duties include:

- Operating a reach truck for internal transport of goods
- Loading and unloading trucks using the truck
- Replenishing pick locations and collecting goods for shipment
- Inspecting, registering, and entering goods into the system
- Working in accordance with strict safety and quality regulations

You will work from Monday to Friday in 2 shifts as standard. A morning shift from 6:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m. and an afternoon shift from 3:00 p.m. to 00:00 a.m.

- Gross hourly wage of € 16,44
- Shift allowance of 8,75% in 2 shifts (then you earn €17,87 per hour)
- Travel allowance from 5km up to 70km one way (€0,23 per km)
- 30 vacation days
- Potential for a permanent contract based on good performance
- Quarterly bonus based on your performance
- Work in a safe, modern, and clean warehouse with a social team

Where will you work?
Schneider Electric is a global specialist in energy management and industrial automation. Customers throughout Europe are served from the distribution center in Helmond. In 2017, the warehouse was named the Safest Warehouse in the Netherlands. Innovation, sustainability, and collaboration are of high importance here.

- In possession of a valid reach truck certificate
- Good command of the English language (speaking and reading)
